request.queryParametersTemplate:
{"query": "fetch security.events
| filter in(event.type,{"VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT","VULNERABILITY_STATUS_CHANGE_EVENT","VULNERABILITY_TRACKING_LINK_CHANGE_EVENT"})
     AND event.level=="ENTITY"
| fields timestamp, vulnerability.display_id, affected_entity.id, affected_entity.name, affected_entity.vulnerable_component.name, vulnerability.stack, vulnerability.type, vulnerability.cvss.base_score, vulnerability.title, vulnerability.resolution.change_date, vulnerability.parent.first_seen, vulnerability.references.cve, vulnerability.risk.score, vulnerability.mute.status, vulnerability.resolution.status, vulnerability.davis_assessment.vulnerable_function_status, vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, vulnerability.davis_assessment.exploit_status, vulnerability.davis_assessment.data_assets_status, event.type
| fieldsRename
    vulnerability_display_id = `vulnerability.display_id`,
    affected_entity_id = `affected_entity.id`,
    affected_entity_name = `affected_entity.name`,
    affected_entity_vulnerable_component_name = `affected_entity.vulnerable_component.name`,
    vulnerability_stack = `vulnerability.stack`,
    vulnerability_type = `vulnerability.type`,
    vulnerability_cvss_base_score = `vulnerability.cvss.base_score`,
    vulnerability_title = `vulnerability.title`,
    vulnerability_resolution_change_date = `vulnerability.resolution.change_date`,
    vulnerability_first_seen = `vulnerability.parent.first_seen`,
    vulnerability_references_cve = `vulnerability.references.cve`,
    vulnerability_risk_score = `vulnerability.risk.score`,
    vulnerability_mute_status = `vulnerability.mute.status`,
    vulnerability_resolution_status = `vulnerability.resolution.status`,
    vulnerability_vulnerable_function_status = `vulnerability.davis_assessment.vulnerable_function_status`,
    vulnerability_exposure_status = `vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status`,
    vulnerability_exploit_status = `vulnerability.davis_assessment.exploit_status`,
    vulnerability_data_assets_status = `vulnerability.davis_assessment.data_assets_status`,
    event_type = `event.type`", "defaultTimeframeStart": "{_QueryWindowStartTime}", "defaultTimeframeEnd": "{_QueryWindowEndTime}", "maxResultRecords": 100000, "requestTimeoutMilliseconds": 60000}
